verses.1: For those who are wise, let them be the children of Korach.
verses.2: Just as a bird cries out for water, so too will my soul cry out to you, O God.
verses.3: My soul is longing for God, for that living being who will come and I will see the face of God.
verses.4: My heart would ache like bread, day and night. Every day, they said to me, “Who is your God?”
verses.5: These memories come back to me, and my soul is filled with sorrow. I walk through the streets, carrying blood with me, until I reach God’s house, with a voice of praise and worship.
verses.6: What shall I say? My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow, and my heart is filled with grief. I will offer myself to God, for He still has hope for me. His face is full of joy.
verses.7: O Lord, my soul is filled with joy. Therefore, I will remember you from the land of Jordan. And the cherubim will sing praises to you from the mountain of Mercy.
verses.8: From day to day, it calls out to your voices, to all your songs and melodies. It has gone beyond all boundaries.
verses.9: In the day, let the LORD’s grace be upon us; and in the night, let our prayers be made to the Lord of life.
verses.10: She said to El-Salai, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do you go in such a hurry?”
verses.11: In my own actions, my oppressors have humiliated me. They say to me, “Where is your God today?”
verses.12: What shall I do with my soul? And what shall I say to God, since He still has hope for me? My face is covered with shame, and I am in great distress before God.
